If sentiment is strongly positive (≥0.67) in the last 3 days, reduce forecast by 0.5–1.5% for early horizon (1–7 days) to avoid overestimation.

If sentiment is strongly negative (≤-0.33) in the last 3 days, increase forecast by 0.5–1.5% for mid horizon (8–15 days) to counteract downward bias.

If sentiment swings sharply (±0.33) in the last 3 days, apply a 1–2% correction to late horizon (16–30 days) to smooth out volatility-induced overfitting.

When sentiment is neutral (0.00–0.33) and forecast is trending upward, reduce forecast by 0.5–1.0% for mid horizon to prevent momentum overcorrection.

If sentiment is consistently positive over 5+ days, apply a 0.5–1.0% downward bias to late horizon to prevent price inflation.

If sentiment is consistently negative over 5+ days, apply a 0.5–1.0% upward bias to early horizon to preempt sharp reversals.
